REGIONS.desert.name: Desert
REGIONS.desert.blurb: Dunes to the edge of the sky, an oasis -- and a pyramid that keeps what goes in.

REGIONS.nile.name: Nile

needs.how: to follow the river through the sands

REGIONS.nile.blurb: A green ribbon through the desert: reeds, hippos -- and something old and scaled that rules it.

SECRETS.desert.name: A lost caravan
SECRETS.desert.text: Half-buried bales, and a carved stone among them

SECRETS.desert.name: In a dune's shadow
SECRETS.desert.text: Warm as a hearth stone, pale as milk

SECRETS.nile.name: A sunken barge
SECRETS.nile.text: Gold in the silt -- and a tablet with a locust on it

SECRETS.nile.name: A basket in the reeds
SECRETS.nile.text: Someone hid it well, a long time ago

PEOPLE.desert.name: Nomad Amara
PEOPLE.desert.says: The sand remembers everything. So do I.

quests.name: Water for the caravan
quests.text: "My camels are thirsty and my people are hungry. Dates, and fish from the oasis."

quests.name: The riddle of the Sphinx
quests.text: "She asks a question and eats the wrong answers. Give her yours."

PEOPLE.nile.name: Kemet the fisher
PEOPLE.nile.says: The river gives. The river takes. Mostly it bites.

quests.name: Reeds for a boat
quests.text: "My boat's more hole than boat. Papyrus, and a few lotus for luck."

quests.name: The old king
quests.text: "He's taken nets, boats -- my brother's leg. Send him back to the deep."
